migration_summary: Low-risk additive nullable UUID column on a dashboard metadata table—no default rewrite, no constraint scan, easy downgrade DROP COLUMN.
migration_sql: ALTER TABLE dashboards ADD COLUMN uuid UUID;
schema_summary: Superset metadata tables are typically modest compared to OLTP fact tables; additive Alembic revisions are common.
risk_narrative: Nullable UUID add without NOT NULL or index is a short metadata change. Superset's Alembic history is dominated by this class of additive DDL, which is useful as the low-risk end of a retrieval corpus.
lessons_learned: Corpus needs successful low-risk examples so the model does not treat every ALTER as catastrophic. Expand with nullable columns first; attach uniqueness indexes and NOT NULL later.
surprise_notes: Even 'safe' additive columns can collide with application assumptions if code starts requiring the column before backfill—but the database blast radius remains small.

prediction_summary.risk_explanation: Nullable additive column on metadata table.
